text:
olivia: Quick Q from yesterday's trip to Amsterdam 22 - airline charged checked-bag fee twice (one on my card, one on partner's card) because we split booking. How should I file? Also boarding pass only available as QR in app, no PDF receipt.
people-ops: Hi @olivia 22. For split charges: submit both card lines and mark which is reimbursable. Company reimburses the business portion only. If one of the cards is personal, attach a short note and manager approval.
olivia: I paid 2340 for bag on my card but partner paid 2335 on their card and they want to be reimbursed. We shared luggage; company covers one checked bag per traveler on international coach. So is the company ok reimbursing the partner even though my card also charged?
manager-lin: Approving reimbursement to partner for their checked bag if it was for business travel. Please add partner name and last 4 digits of partner card in the note and attach manager approval.
finance-raj: Finance needs: 1) card statement line showing the charge, 2) any airline confirmation email showing fee breakdown, or 3) booking reference plus note. If there's duplicate charges, indicate which one company covers. We reimburse in the currency charged.
olivia: boarding pass: airline app only has QR and no separate receipt. Can a screenshot of boarding pass + booking email suffice?
people-ops: Yes screenshots of QR boarding pass are accepted if they show name, flight number, date, and route. Combine with booking confirmation to prove fare/fees.
olivia: lost receipt for a transit card top-up during trip 22 (used for taxis) 22. No receipt, just card balance change. Can I estimate?
finance-raj: Lost small transit receipts: manager signoff required and a short note of route and amount. For frequent transit top-ups, itemize by day and attach any digital transaction history you can pull from the transit app.
olivia: scaling question: if a teammate pays for several colleagues (e.g., group taxi), do we reimburse one person per ride or split lines?
manager-lin: Best practice: submit one expense per person where possible. If one payer covers group taxi, submit separate reimb lines per passenger with names or split the single receipt and add a passenger list in notes. Manager must approve.
olivia: thanks. will upload screenshots, booking confirmation, partner card line and manager note. :thumbsup:
travel-bot: Reminder: attach one file per receipt (preferred), set currency field, and tag expense with project code if applicable. Claims submitted by 17:00 PT on Friday are batched for processing.
